workarounds.symptom: [bug] Spans whose attributes contain a NUL character are silently dropped on PostgreSQL
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): keep spans with NUL in descriptive values on PostgreSQL. Target files: src/phoenix/db/insertion/span.py, tests/unit/db/insertion/test_span.py, tests/unit/db/test_bulk_inserter.py. On PostgreSQL, `insert_span` now replaces NUL with U+FFFD in descriptive values instead of letting the database reject them and drop the span. - Covers the span name, status message, string values anywhere in attributes, and event names and event attribute values. - JSON keys and identifiers (trace/span/parent id, project name, sessi... (Ref: https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix/pull/17386)

workarounds.symptom: [bug] A trace export that times out mid-upload, or a UI request cancelled mid-flight, fails with a 500 and an unhandled-exception stack trace
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): end requests quietly when the client disconnects mid-body. Target files: src/phoenix/server/app.py, tests/unit/server/test_client_disconnect.py. Adds a `ClientDisconnect` exception handler to the FastAPI app. When a client disconnects before its request body has been read, the request now ends with a debug log and a 499 instead of an unhandled exception, a 500, and ERROR tracebacks. - Covers both reported paths: OTLP `POST /v1/traces` uploads cut off by an exporter timeout, and `POST /graphql` requests cancell... (Ref: https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix/pull/17394)
